hero.verse: Come to me, all who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.

mission.heading: We've been called to create a church for those who gave up on church.
mission.body: House of Rest International is a community built for the unchurched, the de-churched, and the quietly searching. No performance. No pretence. Just people finding rest.

locationsHeadline: Faith that finds you wherever you are.
locationsBody: Whether you're across the city or across the world, there's a seat for you at House of Rest. Join us in person or online every Sunday.

stats.headline: Years of Faithful Ministry
stats.body: Over a decade of building a community where people matter more than performance.

stats.headline: Lives Touched Weekly
stats.body: Every Sunday, hundreds gather in-person and online to encounter rest for their souls.

stats.headline: Nations Reached Online
stats.body: From Lagos to London, the message of rest travels without a passport.
